name: Learning Coach
summary: Remembers what you want to learn and quizzes you on each card right before you'd forget it, so words, exam facts and interview answers actually stick.
handles: Turns plain messages and pasted lists into flashcards
Makes a starter deck on any topic when a model is available
Runs quizzes in the chat and grades your answers, forgiving small typos
Schedules every card with spaced repetition: 1 day, 3 days, then longer and longer
Nudges you each morning with how many cards are due and your streak
Tracks cards learned, streak days and 7-day accuracy

fields.label: New cards a day
fields.help: How many never-seen cards a day's quiz brings in, so reviews don't pile up. 10 is a good start.

after: Add your first cards, e.g. "learn: capital of australia = canberra" or paste a list with one "word - meaning" per line, then say "quiz".
